question: Can the current complete three-part authored lamp become an explicit RGB/camera-only reconstruction input with disjoint splits, usable loader and isolated oracle?
changed_variable: One input-bridge addition only; inherited NPR styles, paths, renderer and failed density gates are not changed.
scope: Synthetic input readiness only; no trained reconstruction, main reconstructed proxy, H1/H2, or full-P1 claim.
fallback: Bounded <=5min read-only known-root inventory; absent verified trained lamp, execute frozen synthetic route.

geometry.direction: no hatching or direction field in RGB generation
geometry.training_geometry: NONE; no GT points or mesh in training export

camera.canonical: x-right,y-down,z-forward; W2C row-vector Xc=Xw@R.T+t; depth optical z
camera.export: NeRF/OpenGL C2W x-right,y-up,z-back; C2W_cv @ diag(1,-1,-1,1); pixel centers integer

splits.exposure: New RGB viewpoints, authored geometry and profile already exposed in prior units; this is preparation and inspection, not blind research evaluation. Test RGB inspected for integrity only; no tuning after freeze.

renderer.name: CPU triangle z-buffer, perspective-correct world interpolation, 2x2 box AA
renderer.normal: flat oriented face normals, two-sided triangles, no backface cull
renderer.encoding: linear lighting then IEC sRGB transfer, uint8 rounded PNG RGB
renderer.shadows: local Lambert only; no cast shadows, specular, textures or ambient occlusion

layout.dataset/train: RGB PNG + canonical cameras + transforms_train.json + EMPTY transforms_test.json; only train is reconstruction source
layout.dataset/evaluation/dev: RGB and cameras, separate explicit evaluator input
layout.dataset/evaluation/test: RGB and cameras, locked evaluator input
layout.oracle_only: GT mesh/face parts + per-view output-resolution optical-z depth/world normals/part IDs/coverage, never a reconstructed proxy
layout.metadata: RGB/camera-only loader defaults to train; explicit evaluation purpose required for dev/test; no oracle paths in returned samples

go_no_go.software: all 120 PNG fully decode; exact split sizes and pairwise disjoint angle/camera/file sets; loader returns only expected RGB/camera keys; source and image hashes verified; injected split overlap and oracle/path-escape cases rejected
go_no_go.geometry: all vertices positive depth; all projected vertex bounds >=8px from image edge; every frame >=50 visible pixels for EACH of 3 parts; independent camera axis/center/project-backproject <1e-9 and OpenGL conversion roundtrip <1e-9
go_no_go.visual: inspect ALL full-view contact sheets plus native first/middle/last per split; full lamp present, stem/base discernible, no blank/clipped/corrupt image; no test-driven changes
go_no_go.no_go: Any frozen failure retained with failing views, no angle/material/threshold tuning; no input-readiness promotion until explained
go_no_go.application_gate: actual RGB completeness/part visibility/usable isolated loader; not primitive-array equality

validation.camera_fault: flipped camera axis must fail independent projection validation
validation.isolation_fault: cross-split overlap and path outside split must fail
validation.cold_replay: one fixed train view train_e0_a00 regenerated in fresh child and compared to original RGB, not main quality gate
validation.official_compatibility: read local official RaDe-GS loader source; isolated unchanged camera-reader function execution if dependencies allow, otherwise explicit limitation; no training invocation
